about: Built by tools/build_audrain.py. The Audrain publishes no floor plan: this one is approximate, from the building’s outline in OpenStreetMap, the architects’ and builders’ project pages and the museum’s pages. The museum is one open hall on the ground floor of the Audrain Building.
